projects.title: BaliWasteAI
projects.description: BaliWasteAI is an intelligent, bilingual mobile-first web application designed to help citizens and businesses in Bali manage their waste disposal efficiently. By providing real-time capacity data of local landfills (TPS) and integrating Google's Gemini 3.5 Flash AI for instant waste classification, the app reduces the chance of rejected waste and overflowing bins.
